records.fragment:
- **Dst(raw_operand):** The destination operand. Must have type D,UD,F


- **Src0(raw_operand):** Its type is D, UD, or F (should be the same as Dst's). It could be a null operand, meaning it's zero


- **Src1(raw_operand):** The field **W** further defines its element precision. Must have type D,UD

rule_before_measurement: Targeted layout/row-geometry follow-up,baseline=accepted native FP16/FP32 XMX chain. Mode1=direct INT8 col-major;mode2=direct INT8 VNNI packed B;each uses profile-selected row geometry/store width. Exact same per-row quantization;no extra precision relaxation. Row geometry and scalar/four-byte stores chosen once by median isolated device quantization cost pooled across GU16/22/42,T8/64/256,independently per GU/down and layout. Complete candidate chain checked elementwise against old INT8 chain for every shape/input profile. Every chain includes raw decode/weight+activation quantization,repack,INT32 XMX,rescale,SwiGLU;no persistent repacked cache or uncounted preprocessing. 8physical equal-content weight banks. N2560,F640,down42,GU16/22/42,T1/6/8/16/40/64/128/256;synthetic normal/outlier inputs. Normal NRMSE<=5%,cosine>=0.995;outlier NRMSE<=10%,cosine>=0.98;max_abs reported without veto. Explicit in-order queue without enable_profiling;print/assert actual queue property. Earlier DPCT macro can enable default queue profiling;do not compare wall times across different queue policies. 64warm,8cycles A/B/B/A,64chains/arm screen,128confirm,batch8. Both A/B drift<=3%,>=6stable cycles,median stable throughput gain>=3%. Additional FP16-only queue-property A/B/B/A test:T8/64/256,8cycles,same reps/batch,profiling-on A/off B,exact output equality. If any qualifies,confirm all cases in fresh processes;retain only independently qualifying selected cells. No model claim;production executable/config/source unchanged.

production_queue.rule_before_measurement: Production queue confirmation: accepted specialized native FP16/FP32 XMX baseline vs the exact same vector INT8 candidates from the completed unprofiled-queue trial. Both baseline and candidates use the actual DPCT default in-order queue, assert enable_profiling=true (actual existing engine policy);no profiling callbacks/statistics collected. Mode1 col-major vectors WG256 GU/down;mode2 native VNNI B vectors WG256 GU/WG64 down. Per-row quantization and full output must match old direct INT8 exactly;no additional precision loss. All raw decode,activation/weight quantization,repack,INT32 GEMM,scaling,SwiGLU counted on every chain. 8physical equal-content real expert banks,GU16/22/42,down42,N2560 F640,T1/6/8/16/40/64/128/256. Synthetic normal and 1-in-256 16x outlier inputs;normal NRMSE<=5%,cosine>=0.995;outlier NRMSE<=10%,cosine>=0.98;max_abs not a veto. 64warm,8cycles A/B/B/A,64chains/arm screen,128confirm,batch8. Stable when both A/B endpoint drift<=3%;require >=6stable cycles,median stable gain>=3%,numerical pass. If any qualifies,confirm all cells in fresh processes;retain intersection only. Own process AboveNormal only while awaiting the lock,restore Normal inside acquired lock before verification/compiler/measurement;finally restore on failure. No model quality or whole-model performance claim;production unchanged.
